listen_address.description: IP address the web service binds to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: TCP port the web service listens on.

web_root.description: Path to the root directory containing HTML/CGI files.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous HTTP connections handled.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging if true.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. If empty, log to stdout.

ldap_servers.description: List of LDAP servers to monitor. At least one required.

url.description: LDAP server URL (e.g., ldap://ldap.example.com:389 or ldaps://ldap.example.com:636).

binddn.description: DN used to bind to LDAP server for queries (optional for anonymous bind).

bindpw.description: Password for the bind DN (required if binddn is set).

basedn.description: Base DN for LDAP searches (e.g., dc=example,dc=com).

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for LDAP operations.

starttls.description: Use STARTTLS to upgrade to TLS after connecting.

description.description: Human-readable label for this server (e.g., 'Main LDAP').

refresh_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between LDAP data refreshes.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS for the web service.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if ssl_enabled is true).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file (required if ssl_enabled is true).

allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed hostnames in the Host header (prevents host header attacks).

allow_directory_listing.description: Enable directory listing if no index file is found.

base_url.description: Public base URL of this monitor instance (used in links/notifications).

auth_type.description: Authentication method for web interface access.

htpasswd_file.description: Path to htpasswd file (used only if auth_type = 'basic').
